craft_notes: Sthāyin: support-power scaling. Rows: might then chiefs. Read aloud: rising tread.

lines: By the ground's might alone spell-speed grows and grows —
the elder ground is ever chief, for spells track the ground they stand on;
and each goal crowns its own: so the book-masters.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca ādhārabalād eva adhikādhikamantrasiddhiḥ bhavati iti pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ pradhānam ādhāraguṇānuvidhāyitvāt ca mantrāṇāṃ tatra tatra sādhye tattatpradhānam iti śāstraguravaḥ
